commands.step: Install npm >=11.5 in a sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
# Node 22's bundled npm 10.x signs provenance but cannot negotiate the
# OIDC auth path (the PUT returns a misleading 404). An in-place
# 'npm i -g npm@latest' races the bundled arborist and breaks, so we
# install npm@latest into a sandbox dir and PATH-shadow the system npm.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@latest
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version

commands.step: Resolve tag -> package slug + version (+ remote-tag preflight)
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}"
echo "Tag: $TAG"
if [[ "$TAG" =~ ^(.+)-v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+([-.+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$ ]]; then
  SLUG="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
  VERSION="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
else
  echo "::error::Tag '$TAG' must match <slug>-v<semver>, e.g. townsfolk-hd-v1.0.0"
  exit 1
fi
# Fail fast BEFORE any publish if the tag isn't on the remote (covers the
# workflow_dispatch 'forgot to push' case — otherwise --verify-tag would
# only catch it after the irreversible publish step).
git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
if ! git rev-parse "refs/tags/$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::Tag '$TAG' not found on remote — push it first"
  exit 1
fi
PKG_DIR="packages/$SLUG"
if [ ! -f "$PKG_DIR/package.json" ]; then
  echo "::error::No package at $PKG_DIR (parsed from tag $TAG)"
  exit 1
fi
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./$PKG_DIR/package.json').version")
if [ "$PKG_VERSION" != "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag version $VERSION != $PKG_DIR/package.json version $PKG_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi
PKG_NAME=$(node -p "require('./$PKG_DIR/package.json').name")
PRERELEASE=""
case "$VERSION" in *-*|*+*) PRERELEASE="--prerelease" ;; esac
echo "Releasing $PKG_NAME@$VERSION from $PKG_DIR"
{
  echo "TAG=$TAG"
  echo "PKG_DIR=$PKG_DIR"
  echo "PKG_NAME=$PKG_NAME"
  echo "VERSION=$VERSION"
  echo "PRERELEASE=$PRERELEASE"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

commands.step: Publish to npm with provenance (OIDC trusted publisher, idempotent)
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
# No NODE_AUTH_TOKEN by design — OIDC trusted publishing (npm >= 11.5)
# supersedes setup-node's .npmrc token line. Do NOT add NODE_AUTH_TOKEN;
# it would bypass provenance binding.
if npm view "$PKG_NAME@$VERSION" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "$PKG_NAME@$VERSION already on npm — skipping publish"
else
  npm publish --provenance --access public
fi

set -euo pipefail
if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release $TAG already exists — skipping"
else
  gh release create "$TAG" --title "$PKG_NAME $VERSION" --generate-notes --verify-tag $PRERELEASE
fi
